// Positive control (#5170): the unreadable arm is the ELSE of a `kind !== 'unreadable'` test.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  const plan = readTextEvidence(planPath);
  if (plan.kind !== 'unreadable') {
    return gateVerdict('pass', false, { checked: plan.kind });
  } else {
    return gateVerdict('skip', false, { reason: 'unreadable plan' });
  }
}
